scalars.scalar_value: Experience managing ad-hoc data requests and delivering special-project reports on tight timelines.

items.item_text: Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on Background Check results.
Cover letter required for a complete application.
Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field and / or equivalent experience / training.
Experience managing ad-hoc data requests and delivering special-project reports on tight timelines.
The Business Intelligence and Planning Analyst will be an analytical professional within the Vice Chancellor of Student Affairs and Campus Life (VAC-SACL) division.

The role serves the entire division and reports to the Director of Resource Planning in the AVC of Finance & Operations. The specialist is responsible for turning campus-wide data into actionable insights that optimize resources, drive revenue opportunities, workforce planning, program enhancements, and strategic decision-making across all AVC units.
Applies acquired skills and professional concepts to business analytics projects of small to medium size and intermediate scope and complexity.
Cover letter required for a complete application.
Working knowledge of business intelligence functions and analytics.
Working knowledge of relevant internal databases, BI applications and tools. Ability to produce reports and documentation.

Demonstrated analytical and problem-resolution skills. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to apply statistical methods, data-visualization best practices, and business-modeling techniques to complex dataset
Detail oriented, with demonstrated organizational skills.

Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex information in a clear, concise manner. Strong communication skills for translating complex data into actionable insights for non-technical leaders.

Demonstrated interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with professional and technical staff. Ability to work cross-functionally with all professional levels, building strong stakeholder relationships.
Ability to train staff at a variety of technical skill levels.
Proven ability to develop financial and operational models that influence budgeting and revenue strategies.
